## Outcome

What problem does this address, and what changes for the contributor or user?

## Related work

Link the issue, accepted scope, or registration decision. Use `Closes #...` only
when all acceptance criteria are met.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Include evidence for research
findings, limitations, and anything not verified.

## Sources and policy

Identify source/license considerations. For implementation, link the approved
specification revision. For registration, include the project conformance result
and the review checklist in docs/project-setup.md. A maintainer approves status,
registration, and licensing exceptions; passing CI does not grant approval.
